$description: Round 13 CHAT (Marcus's video comments of 21 Oct, PROPOSED 22 Oct 2026): read and unread in the bell, the creatives in a chat message as small tiles, the @ list over the composer and the panel beside the conversation. Every value points at a brand primitive or an existing UI role; no new colours. Build: node tools/tokens/build.mjs

unread-bg-on-page.description: #9: an unread notification on the page rests on the card surface (Focus 50), so unread rows read as a block before any word is read; a read row is the bare page. Hover is still one step toward Ink.

unread-bg-on-glass.description: #9: an unread notification on Smoke glass rests on the clear veil; a read row is the bare glass. On glass the words cannot step back (secondary Porcelain is never fainter than 88 %), so the veil and the dot carry it.

dot.description: #9: the unread dot, two pixels larger than a badge's, Ink on the page and Porcelain on glass. Never blue, never Amber.

size.description: #14: a creative shown in a chat message is a small tile (64 wide, its own ratio), at most four in a row and then +N; opened, it shows in the panel beside the conversation. The conversation is talk, not a gallery.

width.description: #16: the @ list over the composer (products, collections, campaigns, creatives): a glass float wide enough for a name and its kind on one line.

rows-visible.description: #16: the @ list stops after six and a half rows: the half row says there is more below.
